name: careerlens-ai-monorepo
description: CareerLens AI - Monorepo for modern AI-powered career guidance and resume intelligence platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "frontend,backend,ai-service" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend

author: CareerLens AI Team
